name: PyTorch 入门
description: PyTorch 框架入门，题目按学习顺序排列，取材自官方教程（Get Started / Learn the Basics / Beginner 60 分钟速览）与高星社区教程（Dive into Deep Learning、learn-pytorch 等）：先张量的形状、索引、步幅与视图/复制判定、广播与类型提升（dtype）账，再 autograd 求导与自定义 autograd.Function、前向/反向 Hook，然后组装 nn.Module、准备 Dataset 与 DataLoader、跑通 SGD 训练循环，最后处理 train/eval 模式、LR 调度器在循环里的位置、autocast 与 GradScaler、DistributedSampler 的单机索引账、参数冻结与优化器分组、state_dict 键重映射与断点续训。
description_en: Introductory PyTorch, ordered as a learning path and drawn from the official tutorials (Get Started / Learn the Basics / Beginner 60-minute blitz) and high-star community tutorials (Dive into Deep Learning, learn-pytorch and similar): tensor shapes, indexing, the stride and view-or-copy layout ledger, broadcasting and the dtype type-promotion ledger first, then autograd, custom autograd.Function classes and forward/backward hooks, then assembling an nn.Module, preparing a Dataset and DataLoader and running an SGD training loop, and finally train/eval mode, where the LR scheduler belongs in the loop, autocast with GradScaler, the single-process index arithmetic of DistributedSampler, freezing parameters and optimizer groups, state_dict key remapping and resuming from a checkpoint.

name: 算子合集
description: 手写神经网络核心算子：激活与归一化、卷积/池化/采样、注意力与位置编码、索引与形状变换、损失函数、优化器单步更新，以及 einsum、范数、logsumexp 等张量原语。
description_en: Hand-written neural network operators: activations and normalization, convolution/pooling/sampling, attention and positional encodings, indexing and shape transforms, loss functions, single optimizer steps, and tensor primitives such as einsum, norms and logsumexp.

name: AI 系统性能合集
description: 训练与推理系统的性能和显存账：激活/参数/KV Cache 显存估算、FLOPs 与 MFU、Roofline 与算术强度、算子融合的带宽收益、通信量与吞吐，以及缓存分配器、激活复用偏移规划和 offload 预取时间线等内存侧账本。
description_en: Performance and GPU-memory accounting for training and inference systems: activation/parameter/KV-cache estimates, FLOPs and MFU, Roofline and arithmetic intensity, the bandwidth win from operator fusion, communication volume and throughput, plus memory-side ledgers for the caching allocator, activation-reuse offset planning and offload prefetch timelines.

name: 分布式训练原语合集
description: 集合通信与多维并行：Broadcast / Gather / Scatter / All-Gather / Reduce-Scatter / All-Reduce / All-to-All / Reduce 与 Ring All-Reduce 逐步模拟，以及数据、张量、序列、专家、流水线并行的显存与通信账 —— ZeRO 分片与卸载、GPipe 气泡与 1F1B、Megatron TP、FSDP/DDP、rank 网格与通信组、弹性重映射、检查点与 Ring Attention。
description_en: Collective communication and multi-dimensional parallelism: Broadcast / Gather / Scatter / All-Gather / Reduce-Scatter / All-Reduce / All-to-All / Reduce with step-by-step Ring All-Reduce, plus the memory and communication accounting of data, tensor, sequence, expert and pipeline parallelism — ZeRO sharding and offload, GPipe bubble and 1F1B, Megatron TP, FSDP/DDP, rank grids and process groups, elastic remapping, checkpointing and Ring Attention.

name: 大模型结构合集
description: 大模型的构件与整模型装配：RMSNorm、RoPE、SwiGLU、GQA 因果注意力与 Decoder Layer，Qwen2 / Gemma2 全模型，DeepSeek MLA 及权重吸收后的解码，MTP 多 token 预测、YaRN/LongRoPE 长度外推、滑动窗口与全局掩码、softmax sink、Mixture-of-Depths、Squared-ReLU 注意力。
description_en: Building blocks and full-model assembly of modern LLMs: RMSNorm, RoPE, SwiGLU, GQA causal attention and the decoder layer, complete Qwen2 / Gemma2 models, DeepSeek MLA and weight-absorbed latent attention, MTP multi-token prediction, YaRN/LongRoPE length extrapolation, sliding-window vs global masking, attention sinks, Mixture-of-Depths and Squared-ReLU attention.

name: 优化器与调度合集
description: 优化器与学习率调度的单步账本：AdamW 与各类 Adam 变体（Lion、Adafactor、Muon、AdaBelief、RAdam、AdaBound、AdamP、NovoGrad、Yogi、Tiger、ADOPT、Cautious、Prodigy、Sophia-II、GaLore、MARS、AdaMuon、Lookahead 等）、梯度累积与裁剪、EMA，以及 warmup-cosine、WSD、OneCycle、ReduceLROnPlateau、SGDR、Noam 等调度器。
description_en: Single-step accounting for optimizers and learning-rate schedules: AdamW and its variants (Lion, Adafactor, Muon, AdaBelief, RAdam, AdaBound, AdamP, NovoGrad, Yogi, Tiger, ADOPT, Cautious, Prodigy, Sophia-II, GaLore, MARS, AdaMuon, Lookahead and friends), gradient accumulation, clipping and EMA, plus schedulers such as warmup-cosine, WSD, OneCycle, ReduceLROnPlateau, SGDR and inverse-sqrt Noam.

name: 分词与数据整理合集
description: 分词与训练数据整理：BPE 合并规则的训练与编码、Unigram Viterbi 切分与路径采样、GPT-2 字节级预分词、WordPiece、特殊/Added token 模板与 ChatML 角色边界、UTF-8 偏移对齐与预算截断，以及批 Padding 与 attention_mask、序列打包、SFT 标签移位与逐轮损失权重、数据分片、近重复去重和多数据集混采配额。
description_en: Tokenization and training-data preparation: training and applying BPE merges, Unigram Viterbi segmentation and path sampling, GPT-2 byte-level pre-tokenization, WordPiece, special/added-token templates and ChatML role boundaries, UTF-8 offset alignment and budgeted truncation, plus batch padding with attention_mask, sequence packing, SFT label shifting and per-turn loss weights, data sharding, near-duplicate dedup and multi-dataset blending quotas.

name: 量化与低精度合集
description: 低精度量化与量化推理：对称/非对称、按通道/分组的 fake-quant 与 INT8 / FP8 / NF4 往返、Weight-Only GEMM，SmoothQuant、AWQ、LLM.int8()、QuaRot、GPTQ、SpQR、HQQ、BitNet、MX/BlockFP 等主流方案，以及离群值处理、误差补偿与缩放因子的搜索、位打包布局解包、KV Cache 量化，和部分二值化（PB-LLM）、格点量化（QuIP#）、按损失分配位宽（BAQ）、通道重排与分组（RPTQ / DuQuant）、双侧浮点 scale（AFPQ）与结构化残差二值（BiLLM）等低比特前沿方案。
description_en: Low-bit quantization and quantized inference: symmetric/asymmetric, per-channel and group-wise fake-quant with INT8 / FP8 / NF4 round-trips, weight-only GEMM, and mainstream schemes such as SmoothQuant, AWQ, LLM.int8(), QuaRot, GPTQ, SpQR, HQQ, BitNet and MX/BlockFP — plus outlier handling, error-compensation and scale searches, bit-packing layouts and unpacking, KV-cache quantization, and low-bit frontier schemes such as partial binarization (PB-LLM), lattice quantization (QuIP#), loss-driven bit allocation (BAQ), channel reordering and grouping (RPTQ / DuQuant), two-sided floating-point scales (AFPQ), and structural residual binarization (BiLLM).

name: 采样策略合集
description: 解码期的 logits 后处理与采样：Top-k / Top-p / Min-p / Typical / Top-n-sigma / P-less / Epsilon / Adaptive-p / DRY / Mirostat v2 / XTC / Dripping，重复惩罚与 logit 偏置、对比搜索、多路分布混合，以及 llama.cpp 的完整采样管线阶段顺序。
description_en: Logit post-processing and sampling at decode time: Top-k / Top-p / Min-p / Typical / Top-n-sigma / P-less / Epsilon / Adaptive-p / DRY / Mirostat v2 / XTC / Dripping, repetition penalties and logit bias, contrastive search, mixture-of-samplers, and the full stage order of the llama.cpp sampling pipeline.

name: MoE 路由与专家并行合集
description: 混合专家的路由与执行：Top-k、Expert-Choice、Aux-free、Sinkhorn 等门控，Switch/CV/z-loss/序列级负载均衡损失，容量分派与 token dropping、共享专家与路由专家合成、负载 EMA 与死专家账，专家隐藏激活 dropout（激活后、第二投影前，inverted scaling、训练/推理不对称），以及 all-to-all 分派合并、分组矩阵乘的排序计划与 offsets 切分。
description_en: Routing and execution in mixture-of-experts: top-k, expert-choice, aux-free and Sinkhorn gating, Switch/CV/z-loss/sequence-level load-balancing losses, capacity dispatch with token dropping, shared versus routed expert mixing, load EMA and dead-expert accounting, expert-hidden dropout (after the activation, before the second projection, inverted scaling with train/inference asymmetry), plus all-to-all dispatch/combine and the sorted plan and offset slicing of grouped expert matmuls.

name: LLM 推理 Serving 合集
description: LLM 服务侧的调度与显存账：Continuous Batching 与 chunked prefill、PagedAttention 块分配与页表写时复制、前缀/KV Cache 命中与 LRU 驱逐、请求准入与抢占、SLO/EDF 与每步 token 预算、推测解码的名额分配、beam search 与受限解码、multi-LoRA 热切换、cache-aware 粘性路由、TTFT/TPOT 时间线与 PD 分离的搬运账。
description_en: Scheduling and memory accounting on the LLM serving side: continuous batching and chunked prefill, PagedAttention block allocation with page-table copy-on-write, prefix/KV-cache hits and LRU eviction, request admission and preemption, SLO/EDF and per-step token budgets, speculative-decoding token quotas, beam search and constrained decoding, multi-LoRA hot-swapping, cache-aware sticky routing, TTFT/TPOT timelines and the transfer ledger of prefill/decode disaggregation.

name: KV Cache 压缩合集
description: 推理 KV Cache 的压缩与驱逐：注意力打分（StreamingLLM sink、H2O、SnapKV、AdaKV、Observed/ExpectedAttention、FINCH、Q-Filter、R-KV、TriAttention、Q-Trust）、保留预算分配（PyramidKV、CAKE、层间背包、Palu 秩预算、Quest 页级选择、KVzip 全局阈值）、值合并与重旋转（WKVD、ZSMerge、HOMER、MorphKV、LoCoCo、KeyRerotation），以及稀疏模式搜索、低秩共享、张量积分解（TPA）与文档分段复用（KVLink）等通道/层/序列维度的策略。
description_en: Compression and eviction for the inference KV cache: attention-based scoring (StreamingLLM sinks, H2O, SnapKV, AdaKV, Observed/ExpectedAttention, FINCH, Q-Filter, R-KV, TriAttention, Q-Trust), retention-budget allocation (PyramidKV, CAKE, per-layer knapsacks, Palu rank budgets, Quest page selection, KVzip global thresholds), value merging and re-rotation (WKVD, ZSMerge, HOMER, MorphKV, LoCoCo, KeyRerotation), plus sparse-pattern search, low-rank sharing, tensor-product factorization (TPA), and document-segment reuse (KVLink) across channel/layer/sequence dimensions.

name: 对齐与训练目标合集
description: 对齐与后训练的目标函数：DPO / IPO / cDPO / ORPO / SimPO 等偏好损失与 DPO 的解析反向，PPO 与 GRPO 的截断代理目标、价值损失和自适应 KL 控制器，DAPO / GSPO / CISPO / RLOO / Dr.GRPO / REINFORCE++ 的优势估计与归一化次序，KTO、Bradley-Terry 奖励模型损失、GAE、label smoothing，以及 GKD / MiniLM 蒸馏。
description_en: Objective functions for alignment and post-training: preference losses such as DPO / IPO / cDPO / ORPO / SimPO with the analytic backward of DPO, the clipped surrogate, value loss and adaptive KL controller of PPO and GRPO, the advantage estimators and normalization order of DAPO / GSPO / CISPO / RLOO / Dr.GRPO / REINFORCE++, KTO, the Bradley-Terry reward-model loss, GAE and label smoothing, plus GKD / MiniLM distillation.

name: 推测解码合集
description: 推测解码的草稿生成与验证：Medusa 多头候选树、Sequoia 多分支采样与最优草稿树 DP、EAGLE-2 动态重排与剪枝、SpecInfer 通用 token-tree 并行验证、LayerSkip 逐层早退，typical acceptance 与逐 token 接受判据、Lookahead Jacobi n-gram 与 REST/后缀自动机草稿、tree attention 掩码构造，以及接受率到加速比的解析账。
description_en: Draft generation and verification in speculative decoding: Medusa multi-head candidate trees, Sequoia multi-branch sampling and optimal draft-tree DP, EAGLE-2 dynamic re-ranking and pruning, SpecInfer generic token-tree parallel verification, LayerSkip early-exit drafts, typical acceptance and per-token acceptance tests, Lookahead Jacobi n-grams and REST/suffix-automaton drafting, tree-attention mask construction, and the analytic acceptance-rate-to-speedup ledger.

name: 参数高效微调合集
description: 参数高效微调的旁路模块：LoRA 前向、权重合并与参数量账，IA³、Adapter、DoRA、BitFit、Prompt/Prefix-Tuning，LoHa / LoKr / AdaLoRA / VeRA / UniLoRA / VB-LoRA / C3A / WaveFT / FourierFT 等重参数化，OFT / BOFT / HRA / RoAD 等正交与旋转适配，DARE+TIES 合并与 GLoRA 逆解，以及 QLoRA、多 Adapter 热切换与 Adapter 池共享。
description_en: Bypass modules for parameter-efficient fine-tuning: LoRA forward, weight merging and parameter counts, IA³, adapters, DoRA, BitFit and prompt/prefix tuning, re-parameterizations such as LoHa / LoKr / AdaLoRA / VeRA / UniLoRA / VB-LoRA / C3A / WaveFT / FourierFT, orthogonal and rotation adapters like OFT / BOFT / HRA / RoAD, DARE+TIES merging and the exact GLoRA inverse, plus QLoRA, multi-adapter hot swapping and shared adapter pools.

name: 扩散模型合集
description: 扩散与流匹配模型的采样与训练基建：正弦时间步嵌入与线性/余弦噪声调度，DDPM 前向加噪与反向后验，DDIM 及其逆向一步，ε / x₀ / v 预测互转，Euler / DPM-Solver(++) / UniPC / LCM / EDM 预条件 / Flow Matching 等求解器，CFG 与 APG / TCFG / PAG / FDG / AutoGuidance 等引导算子，zero-terminal-SNR、Min-SNR、SD3 时间步密度与分辨率分桶等训练侧，以及 RePaint / SDEdit / 熵界 / AMUS / VQ-Diffusion / BlockRefinement 等掩码与离散扩散调度。
description_en: The sampling and training infrastructure of diffusion and flow-matching models: sinusoidal timestep embeddings and linear/cosine noise schedules, DDPM forward noising and reverse posterior steps, DDIM and its inverse, conversions between ε / x₀ / v predictions, solvers such as Euler / DPM-Solver(++) / UniPC / LCM / EDM preconditioning / Flow Matching, CFG and guidance operators like APG / TCFG / PAG / FDG / AutoGuidance, training-side pieces such as zero-terminal-SNR, Min-SNR, SD3 timestep densities and resolution bucketing, and masked or discrete schedulers such as RePaint / SDEdit / entropy-bound / AMUS / VQ-Diffusion / BlockRefinement.

name: 稀疏剪枝合集
description: 模型压缩中的剪枝与稀疏存储：全局与逐行幅值剪枝、2:4 及 N:M 半结构化剪枝、块结构与注意力头剪枝，Wanda / OWL / TRIM / SparseGPT 等打分与误差补偿，GSL 渐稀疏调度和动态稀疏训练的 drop–grow 与 STE 微调，以及 CSR / ELL / BSR 编码、元数据打包与存储字节账。
description_en: Pruning and sparse storage in model compression: global and per-row magnitude pruning, 2:4 and N:M semi-structured pruning, block-structured and attention-head pruning, scoring with error compensation as in Wanda / OWL / TRIM / SparseGPT, gradual sparsity schedules and dynamic-sparsity drop-grow with STE fine-tuning, plus CSR / ELL / BSR encodings, metadata packing and storage byte ledgers.

name: 多模态合集
description: 视觉-语言模型的几何重排与对齐训练：ViT patchify 与 Swin 窗口划分，Qwen2-VL 的 smart resize、2×2 patch merge 与 M-RoPE 位置编号，CLIP InfoNCE 与 SigLIP 对比损失，位置嵌入重采样、视频时空 patch 顺序、图像占位展开与混合 batch 整理、Perceiver latent 压缩、Flamingo 门控融合、SAM 提示嵌入与掩码选择、FastV / LLaVA-PruMerge 视觉 token 剪枝与合并（含 IQR 自适应保留数）、Qwen2.5-VL 窗口注意力的重排索引与 cu 窗口边界账，以及 FLUX 二维 RoPE。
description_en: Geometric rearrangement and contrastive training in vision-language models: ViT patchify and Swin window partition, Qwen2-VL smart resize / 2x2 patch merge / M-RoPE position ids, CLIP InfoNCE and SigLIP losses, positional-embedding resampling, video spatio-temporal patch order, image placeholder expansion and mixed batch collation, Perceiver latent compression, Flamingo gated fusion, SAM prompt embeddings and mask selection, FastV / LLaVA-PruMerge visual-token pruning and merging (including the IQR-adaptive kept count), Qwen2.5-VL windowed-attention reorder index and cu-window boundary ledger, and FLUX 2D RoPE.

name: 语音前端合集
description: 语音模型前端的确定性信号处理：预加重与分帧加窗、STFT 幅度谱（n_fft / hop / center 与反射填充）、Mel 滤波器组与 log-mel（HTK / Slaney 刻度）、MFCC（正交 DCT-II + lifter + CMVN），以及整数比多相重采样。
description_en: Deterministic speech front-ends: pre-emphasis with framing and windowing, STFT magnitude spectra (n_fft / hop / center with reflective padding), Mel filter banks and log-mel (HTK vs Slaney scales), MFCC (orthogonal DCT-II plus liftering and CMVN), and integer-ratio polyphase resampling.

name: 向量检索合集
description: 向量检索与 RAG 检索管线：IVF 粗量化分配与 nprobe 多探测归并、乘积量化编码与 ADC 打分、k-means Lloyd 迭代，HNSW 建图插入与贪心搜索，BM25、倒排 postings 与 Block-Max WAND、ColBERT MaxSim，RRF 融合与 MMR 重排，以及重叠滑窗、late chunking 与父子块扩展的分块策略。
description_en: Vector retrieval and the RAG pipeline: IVF coarse assignment with nprobe multi-probe merging, product quantization encoding and ADC scoring, k-means Lloyd iterations, HNSW insertion and greedy search, BM25, inverted postings with Block-Max WAND and ColBERT MaxSim, RRF fusion and MMR re-ranking, plus chunking strategies such as overlapping sliding windows, late chunking and parent-child block expansion.

name: LLM 评测指标合集
description: LLM 评测与数据卫生的确定性指标：困惑度与忽略位的 token 准确率、语料级 BLEU、ROUGE-1/2/L 与最长公共子序列、pass@k 无偏估计、nDCG@k 折损累积增益、few-shot 提示预算截断，以及 shingle 污染审计。
description_en: Deterministic metrics for LLM evaluation and data hygiene: perplexity and token accuracy with ignored positions, corpus-level BLEU, ROUGE-1/2/L with LCS, the unbiased pass@k estimator, nDCG@k discounted cumulative gain, few-shot prompt budget truncation, and shingle-based contamination audits.

name: RL 基建合集
description: 大模型强化学习训练栈的系统与数据流账：优先经验回放的采样与 IS 权重、rollout 跨 rank 重分片与 padding-free 打包、actor/critic/ref 多模型 colocate 的显存与阶段时间线、奖励归一化的批统计管道、异步 rollout 的准入与陈旧度，以及多段 episode 拼装与截断 bootstrap。
description_en: Systems and data-flow accounting in the RL training stack for LLMs: prioritized experience replay sampling with importance-sampling weights, cross-rank rollout resharding and padding-free packing, the memory and phase timeline when colocating actor/critic/reference models, batch statistics for reward normalization, admission and staleness in asynchronous rollouts, and multi-segment episode assembly with truncated bootstrapping.

name: 智能体系统合集
description: LLM agent 运行时的编排逻辑：ReAct 循环状态机与终止/死循环护栏、工具调用参数的 JSON Schema 校验与归一、任务 DAG 的拓扑执行与加权关键路径，以及上下文窗口的优先级压缩与预算装填，以及生成式智能体的三因子记忆检索与工具调用循环熔断护栏。
description_en: Runtime orchestration for LLM agents: the ReAct loop state machine with termination and loop-guard conditions, JSON Schema validation and normalization of tool-call arguments, topological execution of task DAGs with weighted critical paths, and priority-based context-window compaction under a token budget, plus the generative-agent three-factor memory retrieval and the tool-call loop-breaker guard.

name: 视觉检测合集
description: 检测与分割流水线的基础算子与账本：anchor 生成与 IoU 阈值匹配、FCOS center-ness 与多尺度层分配、WBF 加权框融合、mAP 的 11-point / all-point / COCO 三种口径、COCO RLE 编解码与 mask IoU、FPN 融合与层尺寸账，以及旋转框 NMS 与可变形采样偏移聚合。
description_en: Foundational operators and ledgers in detection and segmentation pipelines: anchor generation with IoU-threshold matching, FCOS center-ness and multi-scale level assignment, weighted box fusion, mAP under the 11-point, all-point and COCO conventions, COCO RLE encoding/decoding and mask IoU, FPN top-down fusion with layer size accounting, plus rotated-box NMS and deformable sampling-offset aggregation.

name: 自动微分反向合集
description: 反向传播的逐算子账本：softmax 与交叉熵（label smoothing / ignore_index）、linear/matmul 的 dX 与 dW，LayerNorm / RMSNorm / BatchNorm 训练态，注意力与 FlashAttention 反向、GQA 折头求和，Embedding 重复 id 累加，conv2d 与池化的路由分摊，LSTM 沿时间累加与截断 BPTT，激活与 Dropout、weight_norm 重参数化的逐元素反向，以及用中心差分校验自定义 autograd.Function。
description_en: Per-operator backward ledgers: softmax and cross-entropy (label smoothing / ignore_index) and dX/dW for linear/matmul, LayerNorm / RMSNorm / training-mode BatchNorm, attention and FlashAttention backward with GQA head folding, Embedding duplicate-id accumulation, conv2d and pooling routing, LSTM accumulation over time with truncated BPTT, elementwise backward for activations, dropout and weight_norm re-parameterization, and custom autograd.Function checks against central differences.

name: 数值稳定合集
description: 浮点与归约的数值稳定性：补偿求和与成对求和、Welford 在线均值方差、跳 NaN 归约的计数与哨兵语义、bfloat16 舍入与 FP8 分块缩放、随机舍入的无偏与偏置方向、分块 online softmax 只交换 (max, sum) 的重标定合并，以及先按段缩放再归约的安全 p 范数。
description_en: Numerical stability of floating point and reductions: compensated and pairwise summation, Welford's online mean and variance, count and sentinel semantics for NaN-skipping reductions, bfloat16 rounding and FP8 block scaling, unbiased versus biased stochastic rounding, sharded online softmax that merges by exchanging only (max, sum), and the safe p-norm that scales each segment before reducing.

name: 上下文压缩合集
description: 推理前把 prompt 压短的三个路数：按词级重要性剪词（LLMLingua-2 用小型分类器判「该删哪个词」）、按文档预算分配（LongLLMLingua 按困惑度给每篇文档算 token 预算、两阶段窗口细裁）、以及预填期一次性裁输入（GemFilter 用早层注意力给输入 token 打分取 top-k）。三题都复现上游的精确打分与选择规则，任何一步换一种「想当然」的实现都会得到另一份结果。
description_en: Three routes to shortening a prompt before inference: word-level importance pruning (LLMLingua-2 uses a small classifier to decide which words to drop), per-document budget allocation (LongLLMLingua assigns token budgets by perplexity and refines with two-stage windows), and one-shot input pruning at prefill (GemFilter scores input tokens with early-layer attention and takes the top-k). All three reproduce the upstream scoring and selection rules exactly; any "obvious" shortcut yields a different answer.

name: 线性注意力与状态空间合集
description: 次二次复杂度序列建模的核心递推账：Mamba 的 selective scan 参考实现（deltaA 指数衰减、deltaB_u 输入注入、D 跳连与 z 门、变体 einsum 与数值精度口径）、Gated DeltaNet 的门控线性递推（状态指数遗忘、误差校正写入 (v−h·k)β、按头 scale 与输出读出）、RWKV v6 的 per-token 逐通道衰减 WKV 递推（(a,b,p) log-space 三元组、bonus 只进输出分支、w 加在旧指数上），以及 Gated Linear Attention 的 chunk 并行恒等式（段内含入 cumsum、段间/段内两支拆分、段末衰减按 key 通道逐行）。
description_en: Core recurrence ledgers of sub-quadratic sequence modeling: Mamba's selective-scan reference implementation (deltaA exponential decay, deltaB_u input injection, the D skip connection and z gate, variant einsums and numerical-precision conventions), the gated linear recurrence of Gated DeltaNet (exponential state forgetting, the error-correcting write (v−h·k)β, per-head scale and the output read), RWKV v6's per-token per-channel-decay WKV recurrence ((a,b,p) log-space triplet, bonus only in the output branch, w applied to the old exponent), and Gated Linear Attention's chunked-parallel identity (inclusive in-chunk cumsum, inter/intra split, end-of-chunk decay applied row-wise per key channel).

name: 可解释性合集
description: 打开模型内部的两把扳手加一读一写：稀疏自编码器的 TopK 重构账（减 b_dec 后编码、top-k 不做 ReLU、解码重构与 l0 / mse / max_feat 三项指标）、tuned lens 的逐层仿射探针（W_l h_l + b_l 直读 final logits、按层 CE 与 KL(p_final‖p_layer)、float64 稳定计算）、logit lens 的免训练读出账（中间隐态过 final LayerNorm + unembed、argmax 并列取小、agree 与 rank_of_final 排名账），以及 activation steering 的注入账（同层累加、normalize 语义、cos_before/after 与 proj_coef 正交化账）。
description_en: Two wrenches plus a read and a write for opening up a model: the TopK sparse-autoencoder reconstruction ledger (encode after subtracting b_dec, top-k without ReLU, decoded reconstruction with l0 / mse / max_feat metrics), tuned-lens per-layer affine probes (W_l h_l + b_l reading straight into final logits, per-layer CE and KL(p_final‖p_layer), float64-stable computation), the training-free logit-lens readout ledger (intermediate states through the final LayerNorm + unembed, argmax ties to smallest index, agree and rank_of_final accounting), and the activation-steering injection ledger (same-layer accumulation, normalize semantics, cos_before/after and the proj_coef orthogonalization account).

name: 推理系统合集
description: 推理期把 N 份候选折成一个答案、再把预算折成行为的确定性账本：self-consistency 的答案归一化与加权计票（8 条钉死的归一化规则、首次出现序票仓、并列取先者）、PRM best-of-N 的步级聚合（last / max / min / product 四种口径、answer_scores 乘项、并列取小 index 的 top-m 排序）、s1 budget forcing 的三段状态机（步级截断触发 length forcing、Wait 续跑扣预算、回答按剩余截断），以及 overthinking 指标账（答对/答错平均 token 数与效率比、准确率-长度分箱、best_bin 并列取小）。
description_en: Deterministic ledgers that fold N candidates into one answer and a budget into behavior at inference time: self-consistency answer normalization and weighted voting (8 pinned normalization rules, first-occurrence-order tallies, ties to the earliest), PRM best-of-N step aggregation (the last / max / min / product rules, the answer_scores multiplier, top-m ranking with ties to the smaller index), the s1 budget-forcing three-phase state machine (step truncation triggering length forcing, Wait extensions consuming budget, the answer truncated by the remainder), and the overthinking metric ledger (mean tokens of correct vs wrong answers with the efficiency ratio, accuracy-length binning, best_bin with ties to the smallest).

name: OCR 与文档解析合集
description: OCR 与文档解析的可转写机制：识别头 CTC greedy 解码与 blank 分隔 collapse、文档 bbox 归一化与 2D 位置索引等纯账本（真图/编码器不出，坐标与矩阵全入参）。
description_en: Transcribable mechanisms from OCR and document parsing: the recognition head's CTC greedy decoding with blank-separator collapse, document bbox normalization and 2D position indexing, and other pure ledgers (no real images or encoders; coordinates and matrices are explicit inputs).
